item.description: • Tahoe / Liquid Glass chrome on macOS 26. v0.2.5 (and earlier) shipped with the legacy AppKit/SwiftUI panel chrome on Tahoe even though local dev builds rendered correctly. Root cause: macOS gates the new design system on the SDK the binary was linked against (LC_BUILD_VERSION.sdk in the Mach-O header), and CI was building on a runner with Xcode 16 / macOS 15 SDK. CI now builds on macos-26 with Xcode 26.x, so the released binary opts into the Tahoe rendering. No source changes — same MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET = 14.0, just a different link-time SDK.
